description: Browser -> harness commands. Run each `wire` text through the harness's command check with the `receiver` state (now_ms is the receiver's clock) and expect `expect` ("ok" or a refusal code from protocol.md 9.2). Checks run in the order of protocol.md 5.6, so exactly one code is expected. `signing_input` is the exact UTF-8 string that was signed (prefix + JCS).

vectors.name: prompt_unicode_ascii_escaped_wire
vectors.note: The wire escapes every non-ASCII character as \uXXXX; the signature is over JCS (raw UTF-8), so the receiver must canonicalize the parsed value. The text starts no slash command: it is delivered as literal text.

vectors.name: prompt_leading_slash_is_literal_text
vectors.note: Valid. The harness must deliver it as a chat message, never run it as /server.

vectors.name: stop_valid
vectors.note: Stop: aborts the running turn and clears the remote queue.

vectors.name: detach_valid
vectors.note: Detach: ends remote control for the session.

vectors.name: prompt_valid_high_s
vectors.note: Same command with the signature's s replaced by n-s (still valid ECDSA). Verifiers must not require low-S.
